items.html: And all these four lower Sefirot of the present Beria are the secret of Trans-Jordan, and they are Tifferet, Netzah, Hod, and Yesod of the present Beria. But the Malchut of the present Beria, which was then the fourth Sefira of Assiya, is called Syria, and its rank is inferior to that of Trans-Jordan.
